description: Annual spot trading volume (billions USD) across major crypto exchanges — the meteoric rise of Binance, Coinbase's IPO peak, Kraken's steady climb and the catastrophic collapse of FTX (Nov 2022). This timeline shows how one platform went from a $32B private valuation to zero while another consolidated global volume.
youtube_description:
Timeline visualization of annual spot trading volumes (in billions USD) across major crypto exchanges from the early days to 2026. Watch Binance explode after its 2017 launch, ride the 2021 bull run with Coinbase (direct listing April 2021), see Kraken’s steady climb, and relive the FTX disaster — FTX’s private valuation peaked around $32B in 2021/early 2022 before the exchange collapsed and entered bankruptcy in November 2022 (a real-world corporate implosion that erased almost all trading activity). Bitfinex’s 2016 hack and its downstream effects are also reflected as a dip and slower recovery. These are real, documented inflection points — use this for dramatic chart-race storytelling.

If you enjoyed this timeline, smash like, subscribe for more data-powered narratives, and drop a comment on which crash or breakout surprised you most. Want a custom viz? Tell me which companies or metrics and I’ll make it.
